shared_elements: frontal/standing anthropomorphic figure with elaborate headdress or head ornament
supernatural composite being combining human and animal features
densely patterned relief filling the whole field
ornamented belt/apron or kilt at the waist
raised arms bent at the elbow
repeated scale-like or feather-like textured infill
justification: Both surfaces depict standing, elaborately adorned humanoid/composite supernatural figures whose bodies are covered in dense, repetitive ornamental texture and who wear a decorated waist garment, which is a broad but real correspondence. However, A shows two figures in strict profile action poses with large multi-layered wings, talons and a raptor head confronting a bearded winged man, while B shows a single rigidly frontal, symmetrical figure encased in interlocking glyph-like masks and scrollwork with no wings, profile stance or narrative interaction — the compositional and stylistic conventions are quite different.
